weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; trial child accounts before consent; former users found in the platform and scheduling platform
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-004; P03 G-017
remediation_plan: Onboarding and offboarding checklist for staff and contractor tutors covering the platform, scheduling platform, suite, and website; document account types; end trial accounts; monthly reconciliation; individual sign-ins on the front-desk desktop
milestones: 2026-08-04 former temporary worker's account disabled; 2026-09-30 checklist in use and trial accounts ended; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Center Director time (1 hour a month); MSP time for front-desk sign-ins

weakness: Platform administrators and tutors, scheduling platform administrator, backup console, and firewall management login accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Enforce MFA for every tutor and administrator in the platform; turn on MFA for the scheduling administrator; MSP enables MFA on the backup console and firewall and uses named MSP accounts
milestones: 2026-09-15 MSP-held logins; 2026-10-15 platform administrators; 2026-10-31 all tutors
resources_required: Included in the platform and MSP contracts; about 2 hours of MSP time

weakness: No security or privacy training for staff or contractor tutors; no phishing simulations
source: P07 (AT-02 objectives); P01 R-001, R-015, R-022
remediation_plan: Short annual security and privacy course for 7 staff and 14 contractor tutors covering phishing, children's information, the AI tool rule, and incident reporting; quarterly phishing simulations
milestones: 2026-10-15 course chosen; 2026-10-31 all staff complete; 2026-11-30 all contractor tutors complete; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: Backups not immutable; 30-day versions; one admin account can delete them; no copy of platform or scheduling data; security documents on paper
source: P07 (CP-09 objectives); P01 R-010; P04 finding 3
remediation_plan: 90-day immutable versions; scan the vendor folder and contractor agreements into the shared drive; monthly platform progress export; weekly schedule printout
milestones: 2026-09-30 documents scanned and first export; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded

weakness: Backups never restore-tested; no contingency plan
source: P07 (CP-04 objectives); P01 R-010, R-011, R-019; P05 finding 2
remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample folder and mailbox and reports in writing; quarterly thereafter; short contingency plan with online-session downtime steps and a hurricane checklist; tabletop
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-11-30 contingency plan and tabletop
resources_required: About $300 of MSP time; Center Director time

weakness: Risk assessment never reviewed or updated before 2026; no inventory to anchor it
remediation_plan: Inventory of systems and children's data; July review each year and after material changes

weakness: No security or privacy requirements for providers; no oversight; platform terms allow AI model improvement with students' data
source: P07 (SA-09 objectives); P01 R-008, R-013; P03 G-035
remediation_plan: Platform data processing addendum (written security assurances, no model training, 72-hour incident notice, deletion on request); MSP contract amendment (MFA, technician list, 24-hour incident notice, recovery commitment); yearly SOC 2 review
milestones: 2026-08-28 AI module off; 2026-10-31 addendum signed; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment
resources_required: Outside privacy counsel (in the $1,200 notice budget); Owner time

weakness: No rules for contractor tutors' personal computers; district rosters downloaded to them
source: P07 (AC-20 objectives); P01 R-005; P03 G-042, G-045
remediation_plan: Stop roster emails; rosters loaded into the platform with tutor assignments; POL-02 B.9 device rules; contractor deletion attestations
milestones: 2026-08-28 roster emails stopped; 2026-09-08 program restarts with platform-only rosters; 2026-09-30 attestations from all 14 contractor tutors

weakness: Contractor agreement has no security, confidentiality, device, or reporting terms; MSP not required to report technician departures
remediation_plan: New contractor tutor agreement with confidentiality, POL-02 Part C rules, device rules, 1-hour incident reporting, and deletion at the end of work; MSP term in POAM-007
milestones: 2026-09-15 template reviewed by counsel; 2026-09-30 signed by all 14 contractor tutors

weakness: No retention rules; former students' records and all recordings since 2019 kept; outputs unmanaged
source: P07 (SI-12 objectives); P01 R-007; P03 G-036 to G-040
remediation_plan: Apply the POL-04 4.9 schedule: platform retention settings (recordings 90 days; records 2 years after the last session); purge the "Student files" folder; deletion record
milestones: 2026-10-31 platform settings changed; 2026-11-30 first purge and record
resources_required: Director of Tutoring and Center Director time

weakness: Firewall management page open to the internet; student and guest Wi-Fi on the staff segment; firewall logs not reviewed
remediation_plan: Management page turned off on the internet side; separate guest and student network with client isolation; new passwords; firewall alerts forwarded to the MSP
milestones: 2026-08-06 management page off (verified); 2026-10-31 segmentation and passwords

weakness: Access not removed on departure; credentials and shared passwords not changed; no exit reminder of confidentiality
remediation_plan: Offboarding checklist (POAM-001) with same-day removal, MFA reset, shared password change, and a written confidentiality reminder

weakness: No incident reporting rule; staff and contractors unaware of the district's 48-hour term and Florida deadlines
remediation_plan: POL-03 4.2 one-hour reporting rule; P08 notification matrix; reporting term in the contractor agreement; covered in training and the tabletop
milestones: 2026-08-28 POL-03 and P08 approved; 2026-09-30 contractor agreements; 2026-11-30 tabletop
